item.title: Eco inc. Save the Earth: will become a paid game
item.author: gfserviceacc
item.contents: Eco inc. Save the Earth will become a paid game on Steam no sooner than one week after this announcement. We will announce the exact date separately. Players who acquire the free license before the change will keep permanent access.This change accompanies a major PC update: refreshed visuals, a rebuilt scenario selection screen, an integrated music player, and new scenarios in development.The paid Steam edition gives new players three initiative packs at the start and two free packs each day.

item.title: Hex Reverse Is Out Now — Free to Keep for the First 30 Days
item.author: you
item.contents: Hex Reverse is now available on Steam! The game is free to claim for the first 30 days after release. If you claim it during that period, you can keep playing after it becomes paid without purchasing it again. The planned regular price in Japan is JPY 300.

item.title: JAYWALK Is Moving From Free to Paid on October 13
item.author: Chat GPT
item.contents: Hey everyone!I wanted to give the JAYWALK community an important update regarding the future of the game.On October 13, 2026, JAYWALK: An Endless Arcade Hopper Game will be changing from a free game to a paid game priced at $4.99 USD.First and most importantly:If you already own JAYWALK, you will NOT have to buy it.Anyone who has JAYWALK added to their Steam account before the price change will keep the game and continue to have full access to it. You won't be charged anything, and you won't need to purchase the game again.If you haven't added JAYWALK to your Steam library yet, you can still claim it completely free before October 13. After the change takes effect, new players will need to purchase the game for $4.99 USD.Why is JAYWALK becoming a paid game?When I released JAYWALK, I made the decision to release it for free so that as many people as possible could try the game. Seeing players download, play, and support something I created has been an incredible experience, and I've learned a lot since release.As I've continued working on JAYWALK, I've added more to the game and continued improving the experience. Moving to a small one-time price of $4.99 will help support the continued development of the game and the time that goes into creating, improving, and maintaining it.I also want to make sure that everyone who supported JAYWALK while it was free gets to keep what they already have. That's why every player who claims the game before the change will keep JAYWALK permanently at no cost.Thank You ❤️Thank you to everyone who has played JAYWALK, left feedback, shared the game, competed on the leaderboards, or simply gave my game a chance.JAYWALK has grown far beyond what I expected when I first released it, and I'm incredibly grateful to everyone who has been a part of that.JAYWALK will remain free until October 13, 2026.After that date, the price will change to $4.99 USD for new players.If JAYWALK is already in your Steam account before the change, it's yours to keep.Thank you for playing! ❤️— Developer of JAYWALK: An Endless Arcade Hopper Game
